skillFull: Enters a battle stance at certain intervals to fend off Wasps. The Slide button changes to the Allulose Lance button during battle. Tap the button with precise timing to deflect the Wasps's stinger missiles and create Stinger Shard Jellies. After deflecting all the Wasp's attacks, the Cookie unleashes a Finishing Dash to take down the entire invading swarm in one sweep, and creates Stinger Shard Jellies. Level Up for more points for Stinger Shard Jellies.
story:
Attention! Present arms! For the glory of the Galactic Empire of Planet Allulose!

Helios Honey Cookie stands at the apex of a legion of bees as countless as the stars themselves. A single command from his gilded podium is all it takes for the buzzing swarm to snap into formation, raise vast royal palaces from nothing, and charge across distant galaxies straight into enemy lines.

With ambition alone, Helios Honey Cookie is more than capable of rising as high as the sun itself. And yet, this supreme commander chooses only to orbit his sovereign like a faithful satellite. Strongly loyal to the Empress, Allulose Nova Cookie, he moves before the Empress even gestures, anticipating every need before it is spoken. To protect her radiant glory, he would throw himself into the deepest, inescapable abyss of the universe without a moment's hesitation.

In a universe of infinite and boundless expanse... is there anything richer, or sweeter, than this stalwart Cookie's loyalty?
quote: For the Allulose Empire, which outshines the sun itself!

sections.title: New
lines: For the Allulose Empire, which outshines the sun itself!

sections.title: Cookie Info & Loading
lines: Every last star in the sky shall find its way into the Allulose Hive!
Soldiers of the great empire! Take flight! Farther than you've ever been before!
The Empress's will is my will. Her word is my word.
The Empress's voice echoing in your mind is the only voice you need to obey.
As members of an empire that outshines the sun... Carry that pride responsibly!
If you seek an audience with the Empress, you'll have to get through me first.
For the Empress, the brightest light in all the universe!
My loyalty to the Empress is my will, and mine alone.
A future sweeter than honey awaits our glorious empire!
It is an honor to follow the path of the radiant future the Empress envisions.

sections.title: Tap
lines: You've done will on your scouting mission.
Were there any suspicious developments beyond the empire's borders?
Is there a more perfect planet in all the universe than Planet Allulose?
I will devote every last ounce of strength to preserving the Allulose Empire as it stands.
Confidant and Supreme Commander. Both titles exist for the same purpose: to serve the Empress.
Everything is for the sake of the Allulose Empire...
Her ideals aligned with mine. There was no choice but to swear loyalty to her.
May the Empress's will reach even the smallest asteroid at the farthest edges of the galaxy.
I would rather not imagine a moment when the Empress's will and my own diverge.
To be a member of this empire means standing against everything that threatens it.

rows.label: Neutral
rows.text: Had you presented this to the Empress, you would've been sent straight to the dungeons.

rows.label: Given <u>Imperial Stinger Lance</u>
rows.text: As precious as this spear is, I hope it never has to be used...

rows.label: Given <u>Royal Golden Dough</u>
rows.text: The future of our empire shall shine just as brilliantly as this!

sections.title: Trial Info
lines: The universe is unforgiving. Steel yourselves.
Before us lies nothing glory!(sic)
Following the Empress is the path to our prosperity.
Do you understand what it means to be a member of this grand empire?
Fight harder for the Empress! To the very edge of the empire!
Are you prepared to take flight into the universe?

relations.text: An alien Cookie even our empire hasn't fully accessed. Are you a potential threat?
Exceptional hive construction skills... Meaningless if he has no intention of joining the empire.
An exemplary knight. Joining the empire would be an honor to your lineage.
To reach beyond what already satisfies... Your ambition mirrors the Empress's.
A capable leader, without question. Though we differ when it comes to what's best for a planet.
With the Black Hole's threat closing in, can you truly say the path you've chosen as a leader is the right one?
Throwing yourself in without hesitation for the sake of your own planet... That is worthy of admiration.
Blind loyalty is poison... even to the one it's devoted to.
I cannot forget the day I first saw you. The first moment we shared the very same thought...

sections.title: Cookie Info & Loading
lines: The Empress remembers every rose in this garden.
Standing by the Empress's side is my will, and mine alone.
To receive words meant for my ears alone... I am truly humbled.
The Empress awaits her sweet refreshments and fragrant tea.
A flourishing future awaits our glorious empire!
If you seek an audience with the Empress, you'll have to get through me first.*
For the Empress, the brightest light in all the universe!*

sections.title: Tap
lines: As Supreme Commander, I make a point of conducting myself with dignity at all times.
I am on my way to see the Empress.
Just as her roses never wither, so too shall the Allulose Empire shine forever.
I often know what the Empress wants before she herself realizes it.
Everything on this planet belongs to Her Imperial Majesty, the Empress.
Always take pride in protecting the empire.
The roses of the Allulose Empire are renowned throughout the universe as the most beautiful of all.
My duty is to stand by the Empress's side whenever she wishes...
No one enters the garden without expression(sic) permission. Absolutely no one.
Take pride in serving the Allulose Empire.

rows.label: Neutral
rows.text: What serves no purpose shall be discarded without hesitation.

rows.label: Given <u>Imperial Stinger Lance</u>
rows.text: Though I carry it within the secret garden, the hope that it will never be used remains the same.

rows.label: Given <u>Royal Golden Dough</u>
rows.text: A brilliance worthy of the Allulose Empire.

costumes.info: In the Empress's secret garden, flowers bearing the likeness of the Rose Nebula bloom. Of all of them, the most beautiful rose was plucked by hand and pinned to the one soul ever granted entry. Was it a simple gift, or something more, that was placed there? Whenever the Empress grows bored with the audience chamber and longs for a tea party, Helios Honey Cookie will already be in the secret garden, waiting with a fresh pot of tea. One step ahead, as always...

ingredient.text: Always kept in immaculate condition—so pristine it could pass for a decorative piece. In truth, it is a lance coathed in lethal venom, prepared and held in readiness... used only when ordered by the Empress herself.
